supporting_queries: conversion audit what does it include
opportunity: High-intent searchers looking for a systematic review of why a website is not converting. Slightly broader than landing page audit but shares the same commercial entry point. Needs to carve its own angle: a conversion audit differs from a landing page audit in that it considers the full visitor journey, not just a single destination page. Bridge to free audit CTA.

evidence_sources.description: 892 completed audits. Signal frequency and severity table as above.

angle: Position a conversion audit as a structured diagnostic, not an opinion list. Differentiate from analytics reviews (GA4 data reading) and from UX reviews (heuristic opinions). The audit is about measurable signal conditions versus high-converting reference pages. Walk through what an analyst would check, in what order, and why.
